# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by syntasks.config.dump.config_reference(); do not edit. -->

Units: durations like `"250ms"`, `"30s"`, `"1h30m"` (or seconds); sizes like `"64KiB"`, `"2GiB"` (or bytes); rates like `"100/s"`.

Scope: **node** settings describe one machine; **cluster** settings must be the same everywhere and are published to Redis on start (see [Cluster](../guides/cluster.md)).

## `[app]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | `"default"` | node | Redis namespace: keys are syntasks:{name}:… |
| `app` | str | - | node | Import path of the SynTasks object, e.g. 'billing.app:app'. |
| `modules` | list[str] | `[]` | node | Modules imported by workers so their tasks register. |
| `revision` | int | - | cluster | Deploy revision (e.g. CI build number); orders cluster syncs. |

## `[redis]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | str | `"redis://localhost:6379/0"` | node | Redis URL. |
| `pool_size` | int | `50` | node | Connections per process. |
| `connect_timeout` | duration | `"5s"` | node | Connect timeout. |
| `socket_timeout` | duration | `"30s"` | node | Timeout for non-blocking commands. |
| `sentinel` | table | - | node | Use Redis Sentinel. |

## `[redis.sentinel]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | str | - | node | Master name configured in Sentinel. |
| `nodes` | list[str] | `[]` | node | Sentinel addresses 'host:port'. |
| `username` | str | - | node | Sentinel ACL user. |
| `password` | str | - | node | Sentinel password. |

## `[worker]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `processes` | int | `2` | node | Worker processes; 0 = CPU count. |
| `max_async_tasks` | int | `100` | node | Tasks running at once on this machine (split across processes). |
| `max_threads` | int | - | node | Threads for sync tasks, per process. |
| `prefetch` | int | `1` | node | Messages fetched ahead of free capacity, per process. |
| `queues` | list[str] | `["default"]` | node | Queues this machine serves, in priority order. |
| `tags` | list[str] | `[]` | node | Tags for task routing. |
| `shutdown_grace` | duration | `"30s"` | node | Time running tasks get to finish on shutdown. |
| `memory_soft_limit` | size | - | node | Per process: above it, stop taking work, drain and restart. |
| `memory_hard_limit` | size | - | node | Per process RLIMIT_AS (Linux); allocations above it fail. |
| `memory_check_interval` | duration | `"5s"` | node | How often memory is checked. |
| `max_tasks_per_process` | int | `0` | node | Restart a process after this many tasks (0 = never). |
| `max_restarts` | int | `0` | node | Stop the worker after this many crash restarts (0 = never). |
| `max_startup_failures` | int | `5` | node | Stop after this many worker processes in a row fail before they are ready (0 = never). |
| `loop` | Literal['auto', 'asyncio', 'uvloop'] | `"auto"` | node | Event loop; 'auto' uses uvloop if installed. |
| `loop_block_warn` | duration | `"1s"` | node | Log a stack trace when the event loop is blocked this long. |
| `loop_block_kill` | duration | `"0s"` | node | Restart the process when the loop is blocked this long (0 = off). |
| `ack` | Literal['when_received', 'when_executed', 'when_saved'] | `"when_saved"` | node | When messages are acknowledged. |
| `claim_idle` | duration | `"1m"` | node | Messages unacknowledged this long are taken over by others. |
| `xread_block` | duration | `"1s"` | node | How long one blocking read waits. |

## `[node]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `heartbeat` | duration | `"5s"` | node | Heartbeat interval. |
| `dead_after` | duration | `"30s"` | cluster | A node without heartbeat this long is dead. |

## `[scheduler]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` | node | Run the dispatcher on this machine's workers. |
| `shards` | int | `1` | cluster | Dispatcher shards. |
| `min_interval` | duration | `"1s"` | cluster | Shortest allowed recurrence. |
| `late_after` | duration | `"30s"` | cluster | A fire dispatched later than this counts as missed, even if no newer fire time has passed; its misfire policy decides what runs. |
| `max_catchup` | int | `10` | cluster | Missed fires replayed with misfire='all'. |
| `max_dynamic` | int | `100000` | cluster | Max dynamic schedules. |
| `max_payload` | size | `16384` | cluster | Max size of schedule arguments. |
| `prune_removed` | bool | `true` | cluster | Delete code schedules that were removed from code. |
| `lease_ttl` | duration | `"5s"` | cluster | Dispatcher lease TTL. |
| `claim_lease` | duration | `"30s"` | cluster | Time a claimed fire has to be committed. |
| `max_sleep` | duration | `"1s"` | node | Longest dispatcher sleep. |
| `batch` | int | `100` | node | Fires claimed per round. |
| `history` | int | `20` | cluster | Runs kept per schedule. |

## `[channels]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_handlers` | int | `500` | node | Channel handlers per process. |
| `max_message` | size | `65536` | cluster | Max message size. |
| `retention` | duration | `"10m"` | cluster | How long broadcast messages are kept for replay. |
| `max_length` | int | `10000` | cluster | Max broadcast messages kept. |
| `inbox_max` | int | `10000` | cluster | Max unprocessed inbox messages. |
| `idle_expiry` | duration | `"1d"` | cluster | Unused channels are deleted after this. |
| `lease_ttl` | duration | `"10s"` | cluster | Handler ownership lease. |
| `presence_ttl` | duration | `"30s"` | node | Reader presence timeout. |
| `hub_max_streams` | int | `500` | node | Channels per hub connection. |
| `reader_buffer` | int | `1000` | node | Messages buffered per reader. |
| `max_per_watch` | int | `500` | node | Distinct channels one watch (one connection) may subscribe to. |
| `watch_keep` | duration | `"30d"` | cluster | How long a user's saved groups are kept; renewed on every change. |

## `[results]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | Literal['redis', 'none'] | `"redis"` | node | Where results go. |
| `serializer` | Literal['json', 'pickle', 'orjson', 'msgpack', 'cbor'] | `"json"` | cluster | Result encoding. |
| `keep_results` | bool | `true` | node | Keep results after reading. |

## `[logging]`

| Setting | Type | Default | Scope | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | str | `"INFO"` | node | Log level. |
| `format` | Literal['text', 'json'] | `"text"` | node | Log format. |
| `configure` | bool | `true` | node | Configure Python logging in workers. |
| `capture_level` | str | `"INFO"` | node | Lowest level captured for tasks. |
| `capture_max_lines` | int | `1000` | node | Lines kept per captured run. |
| `capture_max_record` | size | `8192` | node | Max size of one record. |
| `capture_retention` | duration | `"1d"` | node | How long captured logs are kept. |
